measurements.particle_name: LDPE nanoplastic fragments after 21 days degradation (detached, no surfactant)

conditions.instrument: ELSZ-2000ZS dynamic light scattering (DLS) analyzer (Otsuka Electronics, Osaka, Japan)

measurements.evidence_quote: After 30 days of degradation, the zeta potential value was approximately -10 mv, which was 10 mv higher than the -20 mv value after 21 days. || The hydrodynamic size and zeta potential values were determined under pure water suspension at 20 °C using an ELSZ-2000ZS dynamic light scattering (DLS) analyzer (Otsuka Electronics, Osaka, Japan).
